data.title: 圣女贞德 · 大教堂的纯白花嫁·「这份幸福……真的可以由我收下吗？」
data.description: 【沙特尔式大教堂·正午】彩绘玫瑰窗把正午阳光滤成万花筒，倾泻在身着纯白婚纱的贞德身上。她双手捧着白玫瑰与铃兰的花束，长长的头纱自金辫上温柔垂落。听见你的脚步声，她抬起头来，紫蓝色的眼眸里蓄满不敢置信的泪光——为法兰西献出了一生的圣女，此刻终于有人对她说：这一次，换我来守护你的一生。
data.location: 哥特式大教堂玫瑰窗下
data.action: 捧白玫瑰花束立于玫瑰窗光瀑中，闻声抬头，泪光与圣洁微笑交织
data.lighting: 玫瑰彩窗滤出的七彩光瀑笼罩婚纱与面庞
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, rose window light cascade, sacred bridal grandeur
data.promptProse: Beneath the cathedral rose window, Jeanne supports white roses and lilies of the valley in both hands, lifting tearful eyes at approaching footsteps. Her opaque floor-length wedding gown and long veil descend from a golden braid into the train. The wide environmental view keeps the complete silhouette between receding columns. Midday light filtered through colored glass reaches bouquet and fabric, laying tinted shapes across the gown and shaded stone floor.
